aboutGame.title: What is Mad King Redemption?
paragraphs: Mad King Redemption is a dark fantasy beat 'em up action RPG with roguelite progression. You fight through the corrupted realm of Aldermere as one of four playable heroes, rebuild power between runs, and decide whether the Mad King earns redemption or a final execution.

Combat blends real-time spacing, dodges, and telegraphed attacks with a run-based upgrade economy. Four playable heroes cover distinct combat roles, Dark Powers reshape every boss encounter, and up to four players can share the fight in online or local co-op. Every guide on this wiki is built to help you clear runs faster and reach the redemption ending.

explore.title: Explore Mad King Redemption Wiki
explore.description: Eight Mad King Redemption modules cover everything from your first run to the final redemption window. Jump into a section below for hero breakdowns, boss tactics, build paths, and progression advice.

modules.name: Mad King Redemption Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: A step-by-step walkthrough of your first hours: controls, stamina, upgrade spending, and the early mistakes that stall new players.

highlights.detail: Bind your controls and learn movement, camera, and the basic attack before your first real fight.
Read every tutorial tooltip: stamina recovery, parry timing, and item weight hide there.
Commit to one upgrade path instead of spreading early materials across every stat.
Practice spacing and punishes; stop attacking when an enemy winds up a heavy hit.
Keep a healing item in reserve and create distance before you use it.
Clear optional rooms while healthy to bank gear, levels, and lore before the boss.

modules.name: Mad King Redemption Wiki Boss Guide
modules.description: A phase-by-phase boss strategy covering preparation, attack patterns, role assignments, and the redemption window that changes the ending.

highlights.detail: Run the prep checklist: consumables, cleanse, and defensive cooldowns ready.
Phase 1 teaches the moveset; learn tells and hold your cooldowns.
Phase 2 layers add waves and area denial; assign one caller for movement.
Phase 3 opens the redemption window; commit together and execute the action.
Final Stand peaks in density; survive first and deal damage second.
Reset after the window closes; the boss often retaliates in the first three seconds.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Mad King Redemption questions about heroes, co-op, bosses, and the redemption ending.

items.question: What is Mad King Redemption?
items.answer: Mad King Redemption is a dark fantasy beat 'em up action RPG with roguelite progression. You fight through the corrupted realm of Aldermere as one of four playable heroes, rebuild power between runs, and decide whether the Mad King earns redemption or a final execution.

items.question: Can I play Mad King Redemption in co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Mad King Redemption supports online co-op for up to four players as well as local co-op, with enemy scaling and shared rewards tuned around party size. Role clarity matters more than raw damage in a Mad King Redemption co-op run.

items.question: Who is the first major boss in Mad King Redemption?
items.answer: Baron Morgrim is the gatekeeper encounter in Mad King Redemption. The fight moves through a learning phase, a split phase with add waves, and a redemption window that rewards a coordinated group.

items.question: How do I unlock the redemption ending in Mad King Redemption?
items.answer: Mad King Redemption has two victory paths. During the Final Dark Surge, stop attacking and perform the severing action instead of a damage dump to trigger the redemption ending; dealing damage during the scripted beat cancels it.

items.question: Which hero should beginners pick in Mad King Redemption?
items.answer: Start with a forgiving frontline or support-style hero in Mad King Redemption while you learn enemy tells and stamina management, then branch into higher-execution damage roles once the combat rhythm feels natural.

items.question: How long is the early game in Mad King Redemption?
items.answer: The opening hours of Mad King Redemption, from the tutorial region through your first major skill check, usually take one to three hours depending on your build and difficulty. Taking your time is faster overall than skipping systems you will need later.
